source.description: Home (TPL-home, BRF-006) as a standalone screen probe: the default brand's profile and variants applied

/documents/dl_present.description: false = the driving licence was just deleted from the phone; the home shows no card for it

/documents/dl_status.description: Status of the driving licence in the example wallet: valid | expiring (validity ends within 30 days, DEC-060) | expired (document-invalid state)

/documents/empty.description: The selected storage holds no eDoklad

/documents/id_present.description: false = the identity card was just deleted from the phone; the home shows no card for it

/documents/id_status.description: Status of the identity card in the example wallet: valid | revoked | suspended | stale (set while the user was in its detail; the home shows it on return)

/documents/pid_present.description: false = the identification data (PID) were just deleted from the phone; the home shows no identity card

/driving_licence/valid_until.description: Expiry date of the driving licence (synthetic; as its detail) — in a brand's dated status (DEC-052)

/holder/initials.description: Initials of the holder in the identity card's avatar (synthetic; DEC-049)

/id_card/valid_until.description: Expiry date of the identity card (synthetic; as its detail) — in a brand's dated status (DEC-052)

/links/all_documents.description: In-app route to the list of all eDoklady (prototype anchor; the press is OPEN_ALL_DOCUMENTS; DEC-051)

/links/cert.description: In-app route to the certification view (prototype anchor; the press is OPEN_CERT)

/links/log.description: In-app route to the history (prototype anchor; the press is OPEN_LOG)

/nav/tabs.description: Top-level destinations of the bottom bar (EL-bottom-bar, shown where the brand's bottom-nav variant is bar; DEC-043); home is the eDoklady destination

/network/online.description: Whether the phone has an internet connection

/storage/options.description: Options of the storage switch (as-is L789-790); offline the cloud option is disabled and its label says why

/storage/selected.description: Storage whose documents the cards show: phone | cloud

ui_states.description: Online, phone storage selected — the identity card and the driving licence, both valid; Predložiť eDoklady at the bottom
Cloud storage selected — the documents kept in the cloud (synthetic, SLOVAK-CONTEXT-C-36)

No internet — the phone documents stay usable; a notice says the cloud needs a connection and the phone documents work without one; the cloud option stays visible, disabled, and says why (RUL-home-offline)
The phone storage holds no eDoklad — the empty state says so and offers Pridať doklad (to BRF-002); nothing to present (RUL-home-empty)
Cloud storage selected and it holds no eDoklad — the same empty state as the phone storage (as-is L364-365) with Pridať doklad; nothing to present (RUL-home-empty)
The driving licence has expired — its card says 'Platnosť skončila' in text and a notice asks to open it for the reason (RUL-home-document-invalid)
Back from the identity card's detail after it became revoked — its card says 'Odvolaný' in text and the notice asks to open it for the reason (RUL-home-id-revoked, RUL-home-all-valid)
Back from the identity card's detail after it became suspended — its card says 'Pozastavený' in text and the notice asks to open it for the reason (RUL-home-id-suspended, RUL-home-all-valid)
Back from the identity card's detail after it became out of date — its card says 'Treba aktualizovať' in text and the notice asks to open it for the reason (RUL-home-id-stale, RUL-home-all-valid)
Back from deleting the identity card (whatever its status was) — only the driving licence's card is shown, valid; no attention notice (RUL-home-id-deleted)
Back from deleting the identification data (PID) from the phone — no identity card; the other documents as default (RUL-home-pid-deleted)
Back from deleting the driving licence (valid or expired) — only the identity card's card is shown, valid; no attention notice (RUL-home-dl-deleted)
Unread notifications — the bell has a dot and its accessible name says there are unread messages (RUL-home-notifications-unread)
The driving licence's validity ends within 30 days — its card says 'Platnosť končí 12. 11. 2026' in a warning chip; it is still valid, so no notice (RUL-home-dl-expiring, DEC-060)
